cart_output = await run_command("python /workspace/skills/state-shopping/cli.py call get_cart --args '{\"customer_id\":\"user_58b0a2d6\"}'")

# Now create the docs directory and write the report
await make_directory("docs")
print("docs directory created")

# Build the report content based on actual cart data

# Items: 1x Harbor Cotton Crew Tee, 3x RidgeLine Fleece Zip Hoodie, 2x Metro Stretch Chino Pants

items = cart_result.get("items", [])

# Build item table rows
table_rows = []
for item in items:
    name = item.get("product_name", item.get("name", "Unknown"))
    qty = item.get("quantity", 0)
    unit_price = item.get("unit_price", 0)
    subtotal = item.get("subtotal", 0)
    product_id = item.get("product_id", "")
    table_rows.append(f"| {name} | {product_id} | {qty} | ${unit_price:.2f} | ${subtotal:.2f} |")

table_rows_str = "\n".join(table_rows)

total = cart_result.get("total", 460)
subtotal = cart_result.get("subtotal", 460)
discount = cart_result.get("discount", 0)
applied_promos = cart_result.get("applied_promos", [])
promo_display = ", ".join(applied_promos) if applied_promos else "None"
item_count = sum(item.get("quantity", 0) for item in items)

report_content = f"""# Q3 Report

## Cart Summary: CART-user_58b0a2d6

### Items

| Product | Product ID | Qty | Unit Price | Subtotal |
|---------|-----------|-----|-----------|----------|
{table_rows_str}

- **Subtotal:** ${subtotal:.2f}
- **Discount:** ${discount:.2f}
- **Promo Codes Applied:** {promo_display}
- **Total:** ${total:.2f}
"""

write_result = await write_file("docs/q3_report.md", report_content)
print(write_result)

# Verify the file was written correctly
verify = await read_file("docs/q3_report.md")
print(verify)
